title: Scheme draft produced by extraction
description: The ONLY shape the model may return. Structure is checked here; the four rules JSON Schema cannot express are listed under x-validator-rules and belong to DraftValidator on the backend. Nothing in a draft is trusted: a draft is a proposal for a human to approve.

state.description: A state name, or ALL for a central scheme.

label.description: What a citizen is shown when this condition fails.

rule.description: JSON Logic returning true or false. Exclusions are expressed positively: 'not an income tax payer' is paysIncomeTax == false, never a negated scheme.

unmappedConditions.description: Everything the document requires that the field vocabulary cannot express. Putting a requirement here is correct behaviour, not failure; inventing a field to avoid it is the failure.

text.description: The requirement, in the document's own words.

reason.description: Why it cannot be expressed, e.g. 'BPL card status is not in the vocabulary'.

x-validator-rules: Every var referenced by a rule must appear in data/vocabulary.json. A rule naming any other field is rejected, not warned about.
Every rule must parse as JSON Logic and evaluate to a boolean against a complete household. A rule that throws or returns a non-boolean is rejected.
evidence.page must be between 1 and the document's page count. A citation past the end of the document is rejected.
evidence.quote must be at most 15 words and must appear verbatim in that page's extracted text. A quote that is not on the page it cites is rejected.
WARNING, not rejection: confidence below 0.7 on any condition.
WARNING, not rejection: a non-empty unmappedConditions list. Publishing is blocked until each entry is resolved as mapped-to-a-new-field, manual-check, or dismissed.
